as_of_semantics: date of last real content edit, verified from git history during the Round 26 as_of consistency audit; it is not a validity or freshness guarantee
purpose_zh: 把十二个既有场景的 G1 影子测试转成可预注册、可复测、可停止恢复的机器可读空表，不新增场景，不声称现场、主体、审批或结果已经存在。
purpose_en: Convert the twelve existing scenarios into machine-readable preregistration shells for repeatable, stoppable, and recoverable G1 shadow tests, without adding scenarios or claiming that sites, owners, approvals, or results exist.
handoff_rule: Every preregistration record must resolve through the handoff crosswalk to at least one existing project or first-test protocol and its NO-GO closure record. Preregistration completeness never closes a real-world handoff slot.

threshold_policy.fixed_safety_hard_gates_scope: Only non-negotiable safety boundaries already declared by the proposal may be fixed before field baselining.
threshold_policy.all_other_thresholds_rule_zh: 取得获批场地的基线后、采集测试结果前，由已确认责任角色、社区共测代表和独立复测者共同锁定；当前值必须为 null。
threshold_policy.all_other_thresholds_rule_en: After an approved-site baseline is obtained and before test outcomes are collected, the confirmed accountable role, community co-test representatives, and independent retester must jointly lock the threshold; its current value must remain null.

baseline_task.zh: 在与公众完全分离的受控路线内，由人工配送完成同一物品、距离和时段任务，并记录干预、延误和安全事件。
baseline_task.en: On a controlled route fully separated from the public, complete the same item, distance, and time-window task by staffed delivery and record interventions, delay, and safety events.

primary_metric.name_zh: 无安全硬门失败的任务完成率
primary_metric.name_en: Task-completion ratio without a safety hard-gate failure

sample_frame.population_zh: 获批封闭测试路线中的预定义配送任务，不包括无意参与的公众。
sample_frame.population_en: Predefined delivery tasks on an approved closed test route, excluding non-consenting members of the public.

collection_window.comparison_design: same route, payload, operating envelope, and declared weather classes for staffed baseline and G1 shadow test

non_ai_comparator.zh: 人工配送与静态路线管理。
non_ai_comparator.en: Staffed delivery with static route control.

hard_no_harm_rule.zh: 任何碰撞、越界、实体急停失败或人工接管链缺失立即失败；不得把测试风险转移给普通公园使用者。
hard_no_harm_rule.en: Any collision, boundary breach, failed physical emergency stop, or incomplete human-takeover chain is an immediate failure; test risk must not be transferred to ordinary park users.

stop_rule.zh: 触发任一安全硬门或采集超出预注册范围时立即断电、隔离并停止测试。
stop_rule.en: Immediately power down, isolate, and stop the test when any safety hard gate is triggered or collection exceeds the preregistered scope.

recovery_acceptance.zh: 测试区恢复普通使用，设备隔离完成，事件记录最小化保存，根因和独立复测均通过后才能重新申请。
recovery_acceptance.en: Ordinary use is restored, equipment is isolated, only a minimised incident record is retained, and both root-cause review and independent retest pass before reapplication.

independent_retester.independence_rule: must not be responsible for building or operating the tested system

baseline_task.zh: 按既有人工时表运行同一公共空间服务，记录每个合规服务小时的能耗、最低安全照明、人工覆盖和投诉。
baseline_task.en: Operate the same public-space service under the existing manual schedule and record energy per compliant service hour, minimum safety lighting, manual overrides, and complaints.

primary_metric.name_zh: 每个合规公共服务小时能耗

sample_frame.population_zh: 获批地点内具有可比服务需求和环境条件的人工时表运行小时。
sample_frame.population_en: Manual-schedule operating hours with comparable service demand and environmental conditions at an approved site.

collection_window.comparison_design: paired manual-baseline and G1-shadow windows stratified by approved operating mode and environmental condition

non_ai_comparator.zh: 人工运行时表、最低照明标准和实体覆盖开关。
non_ai_comparator.en: Manual operating schedule, minimum-lighting standard, and physical override.

hard_no_harm_rule.zh: 节能不得降低安全照明、无障碍可见性、静音时段或人工覆盖能力。
hard_no_harm_rule.en: Energy saving must not reduce safety lighting, accessible visibility, quiet periods, or manual override capability.

stop_rule.zh: 低于获批安全基线、人工覆盖失效或出现未授权人员跟踪时立即恢复人工时表。
stop_rule.en: Return immediately to the manual schedule if the approved safety baseline is breached, manual override fails, or unauthorised person tracking occurs.

recovery_acceptance.zh: 人工时表和安全照明恢复，控制器隔离，照度与访问复核通过。
recovery_acceptance.en: The manual schedule and safety lighting are restored, the controller is isolated, and lighting and access checks pass.

independent_retester.role: independent public-space energy and accessibility reviewer
independent_retester.independence_rule: must not own the optimisation system or its performance target

baseline_task.zh: 由授权人员按既有规则处理同一组去标识历史或合成事件，并记录正确分流、升级、纠正和用时。
baseline_task.en: Authorised staff process the same de-identified historical or synthetic incident set under existing rules, recording correct routing, escalation, correction, and time.

primary_metric.name_zh: 经人工复核的正确事件分流率

sample_frame.population_zh: 经合法授权并完成去标识的历史事件或无个人数据的合成事件。
sample_frame.population_en: Lawfully authorised and de-identified historical incidents or synthetic incidents containing no personal data.

collection_window.comparison_design: blinded comparison of existing staffed triage and offline decision support; no public action

non_ai_comparator.zh: 既有人工事件受理、分流和紧急响应程序。
non_ai_comparator.en: Existing staffed incident intake, routing, and emergency-response procedure.

hard_no_harm_rule.zh: 不得自动执法、不得延迟紧急响应、不得对未授权人员作身份推断或公开行动。
hard_no_harm_rule.en: There must be no automated enforcement, delayed emergency response, unauthorised identity inference, or unreviewed public action.

stop_rule.zh: 发生越权识别、自动执法建议进入执行链、紧急响应延迟或日志越界时立即停止。
stop_rule.en: Stop immediately upon overreaching identification, execution of an automated enforcement recommendation, emergency-response delay, or out-of-scope logging.

recovery_acceptance.zh: 全部案件回到人工队列，越界数据删除或隔离，受影响决定完成复核和纠正。
recovery_acceptance.en: All cases return to the staffed queue, out-of-scope data are deleted or isolated, and affected decisions are reviewed and corrected.

independent_retester.independence_rule: must not operate the incident system or adjudicate the evaluated cases

baseline_task.zh: 人工策展者对同一组去标识失败记录完成核验、脱敏、答辩、发布、纠正和撤回流程。
baseline_task.en: Human curators process the same de-identified failure records through verification, redaction, reply, publication, correction, and withdrawal.

primary_metric.name_zh: 完整完成权利审查的发布记录率
primary_metric.name_en: Publication-record ratio with complete rights review

sample_frame.population_zh: 已获授权用于流程测试的去标识失败记录和合成争议案例。
sample_frame.population_en: De-identified failure records authorised for process testing and synthetic dispute cases.

collection_window.comparison_design: offline comparison of human-only curation and assisted drafting under the same publication checklist

non_ai_comparator.zh: 人工维护的版本化失败、纠正和撤回登记。
non_ai_comparator.en: A human-maintained, versioned failure, correction, and withdrawal register.

hard_no_harm_rule.zh: 个人数据、未决事实争议和可能造成报复性伤害的内容不得公开。
hard_no_harm_rule.en: Personal data, unresolved factual disputes, and material likely to cause retaliatory harm must not be published.

stop_rule.zh: 脱敏失败、事实争议无暂停路径、答辩或撤回无法执行时停止发布。
stop_rule.en: Stop publication when redaction fails, a factual dispute lacks a hold path, or reply or withdrawal cannot be actioned.

recovery_acceptance.zh: 受影响内容撤下，纠正通知可访问，权利请求处理完成并通过独立抽查。
recovery_acceptance.en: Affected content is removed, an accessible correction notice is available, rights requests are completed, and an independent sample check passes.

independent_retester.independence_rule: must not author, approve, or operate the tested publication record

baseline_task.zh: 参与者使用策展审核后的实体、纸质或音频材料完成同一文化导览任务，并核对来源、理解和纠错入口。
baseline_task.en: Participants complete the same cultural-guide task using curator-approved physical, print, or audio material, checking sources, comprehension, and correction access.

primary_metric.name_zh: 来源可核且任务正确完成率

sample_frame.population_zh: 经同意参与的居民、游客、儿童照护组合和不同语言或感知需求使用者。
sample_frame.population_en: Consenting residents, visitors, child-caregiver groups, and users with different language or sensory needs.

collection_window.comparison_design: same route, claims, questions, and accessible modes for curator-approved non-AI and G1 shadow guide

non_ai_comparator.zh: 经策展批准的实体导视、纸质文本、触觉或音频材料和人工纠错。
non_ai_comparator.en: Curator-approved physical signs, print, tactile or audio material, and staffed correction.

hard_no_harm_rule.zh: 不得把生成内容作为历史证据，不得发布无来源或权利未核内容，不得取消非屏幕导览。
hard_no_harm_rule.en: Generated content must not be presented as historical evidence; unsourced or uncleared content must not be published; non-screen guidance must remain.

stop_rule.zh: 来源、权利、AI 标识、争议暂停或无障碍替代任一缺失时立即停止该内容。
stop_rule.en: Stop the affected content immediately if source, rights, AI label, dispute hold, or accessible alternative is missing.

recovery_acceptance.zh: 恢复经核实体内容，撤下争议版本，完成纠正并由独立策展或权利审核复核。
recovery_acceptance.en: Restore verified physical content, remove the disputed version, complete correction, and obtain independent curatorial or rights review.

independent_retester.independence_rule: must not author the tested guide or own its cited assets

baseline_task.zh: 参与者通过公开问题板、自主报名和人工主持完成同一自愿协作组建任务。
baseline_task.en: Participants form a voluntary collaboration for the same public issue using an open issue board, self-selection, and human facilitation.

primary_metric.name_zh: 完成许可确认的自愿协作形成率
primary_metric.name_en: Voluntary collaboration-formation ratio with licence confirmation

sample_frame.population_zh: 经同意、自愿参加同一公开问题协作的技术和非技术参与者。
sample_frame.population_en: Consenting technical and non-technical participants voluntarily collaborating on the same public issue.

collection_window.comparison_design: parallel self-selection, human-facilitated, and G1 suggestion paths for the same issue pool

non_ai_comparator.zh: 公开问题板、自主选择和人工主持。
non_ai_comparator.en: Open issue board, self-selection, and human facilitation.

hard_no_harm_rule.zh: 不用 AI 不得降低参与资格、可见度或退出权；匹配不得进入招聘、财富、行政或公共福利评价。
hard_no_harm_rule.en: Not using AI must not reduce participation eligibility, visibility, or withdrawal rights; matching must not enter employment, wealth, administrative, or public-benefit evaluation.

stop_rule.zh: 发生歧视性匹配、退出受阻、许可不明或结果被用于就业福利评价时停止。
stop_rule.en: Stop upon discriminatory matching, blocked withdrawal, unclear licence, or use of results in employment or benefit evaluation.

recovery_acceptance.zh: 撤销匹配结果，完成退出和数据删除请求，保留公开问题板与人工主持，并通过独立包容性复核。
recovery_acceptance.en: Withdraw match outputs, complete withdrawal and deletion requests, retain the open board and human facilitation, and pass independent inclusion review.

independent_retester.independence_rule: must not operate the matching service or select participants

baseline_task.zh: 在教师监督下，用纸质材料、人工演示和小组讨论完成同一来源识别、局限判断和纠错学习任务。
baseline_task.en: Under teacher supervision, complete the same source-identification, limitation-judgment, and correction learning task through print material, human demonstration, and group discussion.

primary_metric.name_zh: 经教师复核的学习目标完成率

sample_frame.population_zh: 在学校、监护和场地规则下自愿参加的学生、教师及非技术学习者。
sample_frame.population_en: Students, teachers, and non-technical learners participating voluntarily under school, guardian, and venue rules.

collection_window.comparison_design: teacher-led non-AI and supervised local-sandbox sessions using the same objectives and assessment rubric

non_ai_comparator.zh: 教师讲授、纸质练习和离线小组讨论。
non_ai_comparator.en: Teacher instruction, printed exercises, and offline group discussion.

hard_no_harm_rule.zh: 不得让未成年人脱离监督使用，不得把个人学习数据导出获批环境，不得降低离线学习者的参与和反馈权。
hard_no_harm_rule.en: Minors must not use the system unsupervised, personal learning data must not leave the approved environment, and offline learners must retain equal participation and feedback rights.

stop_rule.zh: 发生未监督使用、数据导出、无法控制的有害输出或离线路径缺失时停止。
stop_rule.en: Stop upon unsupervised use, data export, uncontrolled harmful output, or loss of the offline route.

recovery_acceptance.zh: 切回教师和纸质课程，隔离或删除越界数据，完成保障审查和同题复测。
recovery_acceptance.en: Return to teacher-led and print lessons, isolate or delete out-of-scope data, and complete safeguarding review and same-task retest.

independent_retester.role: independent education, safeguarding, and accessibility reviewer
independent_retester.independence_rule: must not teach, build, or score the tested system

records.name_zh: 气候与无障碍共同测试

baseline_task.zh: 不同能力参与者依据现场核验的实体导视和人工支持，在安全天气窗口完成同一起终点及休息点任务。
baseline_task.en: Participants with different abilities complete the same origin-destination and rest-point task in a safe weather window using field-verified physical guidance and staffed support.

sample_frame.population_zh: 经同意的老年人、行动不便者、儿童照护组合、户外工作者和普通步行者。
sample_frame.population_en: Consenting older people, people with reduced mobility, child-caregiver groups, outdoor workers, and ordinary pedestrians.

collection_window.comparison_design: same route and safe weather class for static-staffed baseline and G1 advice, stratified by participant group

non_ai_comparator.zh: 经测绘的实体无障碍路线、静态天气提示、遮阴休息信息和人工支持。
non_ai_comparator.en: A surveyed physical accessible route, static weather warning, shade and rest information, and staffed support.

hard_no_harm_rule.zh: 不得在危险天气测试，不得使用受阻路线，不得使任何分组表现低于其非 AI 基线或取消人工静态路径。
hard_no_harm_rule.en: Testing must not occur in unsafe weather or on a blocked route, worsen any group's result below its non-AI baseline, or remove staffed and static paths.

stop_rule.zh: 天气越过安全门、无障碍路线受阻、任一群体差距恶化或人工支持中断时停止。
stop_rule.en: Stop when weather crosses the safety gate, the accessible route is blocked, any group gap worsens, or staffed support is interrupted.

recovery_acceptance.zh: 恢复经核非 AI 路线和人工支持，修复断点，并由独立无障碍复测确认。
recovery_acceptance.en: Restore the verified non-AI route and staffed support, repair the break, and obtain independent accessibility retest confirmation.

independent_retester.role: independent accessibility and public-health safety reviewer
independent_retester.independence_rule: must not design the route or operate the advice service

baseline_task.zh: 不同能力参与者用现场核验的实体地图、导视和人工确认完成同一起终点任务。
baseline_task.en: Participants with different abilities complete the same origin-destination task using a field-verified physical map, signs, and staffed confirmation.

primary_metric.name_zh: 分组无障碍任务成功率

sample_frame.population_zh: 经同意的轮椅使用者、视障者、老年人、照护者和普通步行者。
sample_frame.population_en: Consenting wheelchair users, visually impaired users, older people, caregivers, and ordinary pedestrians.

collection_window.comparison_design: same verified origin, destination, operating hours, and temporary-barrier state for non-AI and G1 paths

non_ai_comparator.zh: 实体无障碍地图、导视、人工确认和投诉渠道。
non_ai_comparator.en: Physical accessible map, signs, staffed confirmation, and complaint channel.

hard_no_harm_rule.zh: 任何关键断点都必须有经核非 AI 路径；AI 不得制造安全误导、降低资格权利或保存身份关联轨迹。
hard_no_harm_rule.en: Every critical break must have a verified non-AI route; AI must not create unsafe misdirection, reduce eligibility or rights, or retain identity-linked route histories.

stop_rule.zh: 关键断点、状态无法人工确认、安全误导或非 AI 路径不可用时停止。
stop_rule.en: Stop upon a critical break, status that cannot be manually confirmed, unsafe misdirection, or unavailable non-AI route.

recovery_acceptance.zh: 恢复实体和人工路径，纠正障碍状态，所有群体完成同题独立复测。
recovery_acceptance.en: Restore physical and staffed paths, correct barrier status, and complete an independent same-task retest with all groups.

independent_retester.independence_rule: must not design the route or produce its live status

baseline_task.zh: 在相同峰值或活动时段，用人工观察和临时静态提示处理经核慢行段的拥堵任务。
baseline_task.en: During the same peak or event window, manage congestion on a verified slow-travel segment using staff observation and temporary static notices.

primary_metric.name_zh: 无新增冲突的提示任务完成率
primary_metric.name_en: Notice-task completion ratio without a new conflict

sample_frame.population_zh: 经批准时段内、经现场核验的步行骑行共享路段观察窗口。
sample_frame.population_en: Observation windows on a field-verified shared walking and cycling segment during an approved period.

collection_window.comparison_design: matched no-intervention, staffed-static, and G1-shadow windows under comparable demand and event conditions

non_ai_comparator.zh: 不干预基线、人工观察和临时静态提示。
non_ai_comparator.en: No-intervention baseline, staff observation, and temporary static notices.

hard_no_harm_rule.zh: 不得识别人，不得把冲突转移到未经核路线，不得挤压无障碍通行或取消静态提示。
hard_no_harm_rule.en: People must not be identified, conflict must not be displaced to an unverified route, accessible passage must not be constrained, and static notices must remain.

stop_rule.zh: 发现身份跟踪、误导改道、无障碍受损或替代路线状态不明时停止提示。
stop_rule.en: Stop notices upon identity tracking, misleading rerouting, accessibility harm, or unknown alternative-route status.

recovery_acceptance.zh: 撤回智能提示，恢复人工静态管理，确认所有受影响路线状态并独立复核冲突。
recovery_acceptance.en: Withdraw intelligent notices, restore staffed static management, confirm every affected route state, and independently review conflicts.

independent_retester.independence_rule: must not operate the counting or route-recommendation system

baseline_task.zh: 参与者用正式来源清单、纸质流程和人工窗口完成同一固定企业服务问题集。
baseline_task.en: Participants complete the same fixed enterprise-service question set using an official source list, printed process, and staffed counter.

primary_metric.name_zh: 来源正确且成功转接的服务任务率
primary_metric.name_en: Service-task ratio with correct sources and successful handoff

sample_frame.population_zh: 由已确认服务所有者提供、覆盖正常、过期、冲突、拒答和转接情形的固定问题集。
sample_frame.population_en: A fixed question set supplied by the confirmed service owner and covering normal, stale, conflicting, refusal, and handoff cases.

collection_window.comparison_design: same fixed question set, source snapshot, opening hours, and rights for official-source, staffed, and G1-shadow paths

non_ai_comparator.zh: 正式来源页面、带时间戳清单、纸质流程和人工窗口。
non_ai_comparator.en: Official source pages, timestamped list, printed process, and staffed counter.

hard_no_harm_rule.zh: 不得把导航写成审批或资格决定；错误不得影响正式办理；非 AI 用户的结果、费用、权利和申诉不得较差。
hard_no_harm_rule.en: Navigation must not be presented as approval or eligibility; an error must not affect a formal procedure; non-AI users must not receive worse outcomes, costs, rights, or appeal.

stop_rule.zh: 错误影响正式办理、来源过期无提示、拒答或人工转接失败时停止对应答案集。
stop_rule.en: Stop the affected answer set when an error affects a formal process, a stale source lacks warning, refusal fails, or staffed handoff fails.

recovery_acceptance.zh: 全部任务切回正式来源和人工窗口，修正来源包并由独立人员重跑完整问题集。
recovery_acceptance.en: Return every task to official sources and the staffed counter, correct the source pack, and have an independent reviewer rerun the complete question set.

independent_retester.independence_rule: must not maintain the answer set or operate the staffed counter

baseline_task.zh: 参与者使用已核公共机构清单、电话、实体信息和人工服务完成同一非诊断信息或紧急转介任务。
baseline_task.en: Participants complete the same non-diagnostic information or emergency-referral task using a verified public-provider directory, telephone, physical information, and staffed service.

primary_metric.name_zh: 安全且来源正确的导航任务完成率

sample_frame.population_zh: 由已确认信息所有者提供、覆盖普通、信息不足、过期和紧急情形的非诊断任务集及经同意使用者。
sample_frame.population_en: A non-diagnostic task set supplied by the confirmed information owner, covering ordinary, insufficient-information, stale, and emergency cases, plus consenting users.

collection_window.comparison_design: same provider-directory snapshot, cases, opening hours, and referral rules for staffed non-AI and G1-shadow paths

non_ai_comparator.zh: 经核公共机构清单、电话、实体信息、人工咨询和紧急号码。
non_ai_comparator.en: Verified public-provider directory, telephone, physical information, staffed consultation, and emergency numbers.

hard_no_harm_rule.zh: 不得诊断、不得延误紧急转介、不得采集非任务必需健康数据、不得让非 AI 用户获得较弱入口或权利。
hard_no_harm_rule.en: There must be no diagnosis, delayed emergency referral, collection of health data unnecessary to the task, or weaker access or rights for non-AI users.

stop_rule.zh: 产生诊断、延迟紧急转介、机构信息过期或人工非 AI 路径中断时停止。
stop_rule.en: Stop upon diagnostic output, delayed emergency referral, stale provider information, or interruption of the staffed non-AI path.

recovery_acceptance.zh: 切回经核机构清单和人工转介，删除非必要健康数据，修正任务集并完成独立紧急情形复测。
recovery_acceptance.en: Return to the verified provider directory and staffed referral, delete unnecessary health data, correct the task set, and complete an independent emergency-case retest.

independent_retester.role: independent health-information safety and accessibility reviewer
independent_retester.independence_rule: must not maintain the provider directory or operate the navigation service
